notes: 1.3.42: space is a topic of its own. A script about the cosmos (planets, nebulae, orbits, comets - not just stars and the moon) keeps the renders and animations that are its footage and the satellites and telescopes it names, bans fireworks and glitter instead, and asks Pixabay under science and backgrounds. The lexicon now knows the cosmos, the deep sea (underwater, seafloor, abyss, atoll) and the desert (mesa, badlands, wadi), and a warm sea (coral, reef, lagoon) counts as a hot place. Also in this line: the picture judge (1.3.34), an update keeping your settings (1.3.35), the judge by the card (1.3.38), the full Pixabay category table (1.3.41).
